sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
We appreciate your proposal for faster payment and a 24-month contract duration.
In exchange for the 14-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.87 per unit.
Please provide the formal data supporting your binding volume commitment of 20,000 pieces per year.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We have reviewed your volume forecast, but it does not allow for further price reductions on our end.
In response to your request for a 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, we can offer €4.91 per unit.
This reflects our firm pricing position for these terms.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We acknowledge your revised packages structured around payment and contract length. 

We are pleased to present our offer at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We cannot offer further reductions, as this already reflects our best possible terms for this setup. 

For your information, our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 7 days. 

We greatly value our business relationship with you and look forward to your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
